outcome: neurodevelopmental outcomes (developmental delay, tone abnormalities, abnormal hearing)
cohort: 57 Extremely Low Birth Weight (ELBW) infants admitted to a Level-3 NICU in South India were initially included, with 12 survivors followed up for one year.
finding: The study revealed high mortality and morbidity among ELBW infants, with a majority of survivors demonstrating delayed neurodevelopmental outcomes despite some catch-up in growth, and lower birth weight was significantly associated with developmental delay.
